															India Post GDS July 2026: Document Required to Be Uploaded

															1. Recent Photograph Requirements

															
																
																Format: JPG/JPEG only.
																
																
																File Size: Between 30 KB and 100 KB.
																
																
																Dimensions: Recommended 320 × 400 pixels (4:5 aspect ratio).
																
																
																Resolution: 72 to 150 DPI.
																
																
																Appearance: * Plain white or light-colored background.

																
																	
																	Face must occupy 70–80% of the frame.
																	
																	
																	Must be clear, well-lit, and in focus (no selfies or scanned photos).
																	
																
																
															

															2. Signature Requirements

															
																
																Format: JPG/JPEG only.
																
																
																File Size: Between 20 KB and 100 KB.
																
																
																Dimensions: Recommended 300 × 120 pixels (5:2 aspect ratio).
																
																
																Method: Scanned signature on white paper using a black or blue pen.
																
																
																Appearance:

																
																	
																	Signature must occupy 70–80% of the image area.
																	
																	
																	No digital/typed text, shadows, or borders.
																	
																	
																	Must be clear and not shaky or pixelated.
																	
																
																
															

															⚠️ Important Notes

															
																
																Rejection Risk: Applications with blurred photos or blurred/miniature signatures will be rejected.
																
																
																Verification: You must check the preview carefully before final submission.
																
																
																No Edits: No requests for corrections or replacements will be accepted after the final submission.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Instructions for applicants
															(For registration and submission of the online application form)

															Part A: One-Time Registration (OTR)

															
																
																Registration Link: Applicants must register at indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement to obtain a unique Registration Number.
																
																
																Prerequisites: You must have an active mobile number and email ID, both of which will be verified via OTP.
																
																
																Required Details: Keep your 10th-grade (Matriculation) board information and passing year ready.
																
																
																Mandatory Info: You will need to enter personal details (Name, DOB, Gender, Parents' names, etc.) exactly as they appear on your 10th-grade certificate.
																
																
																Credentials: After submission, a registration number and a random password will be sent to your mobile.
																
																
																Restrictions: * Mobile numbers and email IDs cannot be modified once registered.

																
																	
																	Only one registration per mobile number/email ID is allowed.
																	
																	
																	Duplicate registrations through altered details will lead to removal from the selection process.
																	
																
																
															

															 

															Part B: Filling of Online Application

															
																
																Login: Use your Registration Number and the password received via SMS.
																
																
																Application Stages:

																
																	
																	Personal Details: These are auto-populated from your OTR data; you must fill in any remaining info.
																	
																	
																	Educational Details: Select your 10th-class board, passing year, and enter your marks.
																	
																	
																	Post Preference: Select your preferred Division and post based on the local language you studied.
																	
																	
																	Uploads: You must upload a recent photo and signature according to the specific prescribed formats.
																	
																
																
																
																Final Review: You can preview and edit your application before the final submission.
																
																
																Fee Payment: If applicable, the system will prompt for payment before the final submission.
																
															

															 

															Critical Reminders

															
																
																Accuracy: Incorrect information, especially regarding your name or parents' names, may result in the cancellation of your candidature.
																
																
																Edits: Registration details can only be edited during the application submission process by clicking "Click here to update the registration data".
																
															
															
														
														
															
															India Post GDS July 2026: Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale:  BPM- Rs.12,000- 14,500 /-  ||  ABPM/ Dak Sevak-Rs.10,000- 12,000/-
																Selection Process:- Selection on the Basis of Merit List.
															
															
														
														
														
	
	📋 How to Apply India Post GDS July 2026 Online Form (Schedule-II)

	
		Visit the official GDS portal indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement.
		Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) from 31 August 2026 to 19 September 2026 (upto 5:00 PM) using mobile number and email ID.
		Log in with your Registration Number and the password received on SMS.
		Click “Apply Online” under GDS Online Engagement Schedule-II, July-2026 (Active Notification).
		Fill personal and educational details exactly as per 10th / Matriculation certificate, select one Division and post preferences (BPM / ABPM / Dak Sevak).
		Upload recent photograph and signature in the prescribed JPG/JPEG format.
		Pay the application fee of Rs. 100 online (if applicable). Fee is exempted for Female, SC/ST, PwBD and Transwomen candidates.
		Submit the form between 02 September 2026 and 21 September 2026 (upto 5:00 PM) and take a printout of the confirmation page.
	

	Note: Apply only through the official portal. No documents other than photo and signature need to be uploaded with the form. Correction window: 23–24 September 2026 (upto 5:00 PM).

															India Post GDS July 2026: Document Required to Be Uploaded

															1. Recent Photograph Requirements

															
																
																Format: JPG/JPEG only.
																
																
																File Size: Between 30 KB and 100 KB.
																
																
																Dimensions: Recommended 320 × 400 pixels (4:5 aspect ratio).
																
																
																Resolution: 72 to 150 DPI.
																
																
																Appearance: * Plain white or light-colored background.

																
																	
																	Face must occupy 70–80% of the frame.
																	
																	
																	Must be clear, well-lit, and in focus (no selfies or scanned photos).
																	
																
																
															

															2. Signature Requirements

															
																
																Format: JPG/JPEG only.
																
																
																File Size: Between 20 KB and 100 KB.
																
																
																Dimensions: Recommended 300 × 120 pixels (5:2 aspect ratio).
																
																
																Method: Scanned signature on white paper using a black or blue pen.
																
																
																Appearance:

																
																	
																	Signature must occupy 70–80% of the image area.
																	
																	
																	No digital/typed text, shadows, or borders.
																	
																	
																	Must be clear and not shaky or pixelated.
																	
																
																
															

															⚠️ Important Notes

															
																
																Rejection Risk: Applications with blurred photos or blurred/miniature signatures will be rejected.
																
																
																Verification: You must check the preview carefully before final submission.
																
																
																No Edits: No requests for corrections or replacements will be accepted after the final submission.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Instructions for applicants
															(For registration and submission of the online application form)

															Part A: One-Time Registration (OTR)

															
																
																Registration Link: Applicants must register at indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement to obtain a unique Registration Number.
																
																
																Prerequisites: You must have an active mobile number and email ID, both of which will be verified via OTP.
																
																
																Required Details: Keep your 10th-grade (Matriculation) board information and passing year ready.
																
																
																Mandatory Info: You will need to enter personal details (Name, DOB, Gender, Parents' names, etc.) exactly as they appear on your 10th-grade certificate.
																
																
																Credentials: After submission, a registration number and a random password will be sent to your mobile.
																
																
																Restrictions: * Mobile numbers and email IDs cannot be modified once registered.

																
																	
																	Only one registration per mobile number/email ID is allowed.
																	
																	
																	Duplicate registrations through altered details will lead to removal from the selection process.
																	
																
																
															

															 

															Part B: Filling of Online Application

															
																
																Login: Use your Registration Number and the password received via SMS.
																
																
																Application Stages:

																
																	
																	Personal Details: These are auto-populated from your OTR data; you must fill in any remaining info.
																	
																	
																	Educational Details: Select your 10th-class board, passing year, and enter your marks.
																	
																	
																	Post Preference: Select your preferred Division and post based on the local language you studied.
																	
																	
																	Uploads: You must upload a recent photo and signature according to the specific prescribed formats.
																	
																
																
																
																Final Review: You can preview and edit your application before the final submission.
																
																
																Fee Payment: If applicable, the system will prompt for payment before the final submission.
																
															

															 

															Critical Reminders

															
																
																Accuracy: Incorrect information, especially regarding your name or parents' names, may result in the cancellation of your candidature.
																
																
																Edits: Registration details can only be edited during the application submission process by clicking "Click here to update the registration data".
																
															
															
														
														
															
															India Post GDS July 2026: Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale:  BPM- Rs.12,000- 14,500 /-  ||  ABPM/ Dak Sevak-Rs.10,000- 12,000/-
																Selection Process:- Selection on the Basis of Merit List.

															India Post GDS July 2026: Document Required to Be Uploaded

															1. Recent Photograph Requirements

															
																
																Format: JPG/JPEG only.
																
																
																File Size: Between 30 KB and 100 KB.
																
																
																Dimensions: Recommended 320 × 400 pixels (4:5 aspect ratio).
																
																
																Resolution: 72 to 150 DPI.
																
																
																Appearance: * Plain white or light-colored background.

																
																	
																	Face must occupy 70–80% of the frame.
																	
																	
																	Must be clear, well-lit, and in focus (no selfies or scanned photos).
																	
																
																
															

															2. Signature Requirements

															
																
																Format: JPG/JPEG only.
																
																
																File Size: Between 20 KB and 100 KB.
																
																
																Dimensions: Recommended 300 × 120 pixels (5:2 aspect ratio).
																
																
																Method: Scanned signature on white paper using a black or blue pen.
																
																
																Appearance:

																
																	
																	Signature must occupy 70–80% of the image area.
																	
																	
																	No digital/typed text, shadows, or borders.
																	
																	
																	Must be clear and not shaky or pixelated.
																	
																
																
															

															⚠️ Important Notes

															
																
																Rejection Risk: Applications with blurred photos or blurred/miniature signatures will be rejected.
																
																
																Verification: You must check the preview carefully before final submission.
																
																
																No Edits: No requests for corrections or replacements will be accepted after the final submission.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Instructions for applicants
															(For registration and submission of the online application form)

															Part A: One-Time Registration (OTR)

															
																
																Registration Link: Applicants must register at indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement to obtain a unique Registration Number.
																
																
																Prerequisites: You must have an active mobile number and email ID, both of which will be verified via OTP.
																
																
																Required Details: Keep your 10th-grade (Matriculation) board information and passing year ready.
																
																
																Mandatory Info: You will need to enter personal details (Name, DOB, Gender, Parents' names, etc.) exactly as they appear on your 10th-grade certificate.
																
																
																Credentials: After submission, a registration number and a random password will be sent to your mobile.
																
																
																Restrictions: * Mobile numbers and email IDs cannot be modified once registered.

																
																	
																	Only one registration per mobile number/email ID is allowed.
																	
																	
																	Duplicate registrations through altered details will lead to removal from the selection process.
																	
																
																
															

															 

															Part B: Filling of Online Application

															
																
																Login: Use your Registration Number and the password received via SMS.
																
																
																Application Stages:

																
																	
																	Personal Details: These are auto-populated from your OTR data; you must fill in any remaining info.
																	
																	
																	Educational Details: Select your 10th-class board, passing year, and enter your marks.
																	
																	
																	Post Preference: Select your preferred Division and post based on the local language you studied.
																	
																	
																	Uploads: You must upload a recent photo and signature according to the specific prescribed formats.
																	
																
																
																
																Final Review: You can preview and edit your application before the final submission.
																
																
																Fee Payment: If applicable, the system will prompt for payment before the final submission.
																
															

															 

															Critical Reminders

															
																
																Accuracy: Incorrect information, especially regarding your name or parents' names, may result in the cancellation of your candidature.
																
																
																Edits: Registration details can only be edited during the application submission process by clicking "Click here to update the registration data".
																
															
															
														
														
															
															India Post GDS July 2026: Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale:  BPM- Rs.12,000- 14,500 /-  ||  ABPM/ Dak Sevak-Rs.10,000- 12,000/-
																Selection Process:- Selection on the Basis of Merit List.

															India Post GDS July 2026: Document Required to Be Uploaded

															1. Recent Photograph Requirements

															
																
																Format: JPG/JPEG only.
																
																
																File Size: Between 30 KB and 100 KB.
																
																
																Dimensions: Recommended 320 × 400 pixels (4:5 aspect ratio).
																
																
																Resolution: 72 to 150 DPI.
																
																
																Appearance: * Plain white or light-colored background.

																
																	
																	Face must occupy 70–80% of the frame.
																	
																	
																	Must be clear, well-lit, and in focus (no selfies or scanned photos).
																	
																
																
															

															2. Signature Requirements

															
																
																Format: JPG/JPEG only.
																
																
																File Size: Between 20 KB and 100 KB.
																
																
																Dimensions: Recommended 300 × 120 pixels (5:2 aspect ratio).
																
																
																Method: Scanned signature on white paper using a black or blue pen.
																
																
																Appearance:

																
																	
																	Signature must occupy 70–80% of the image area.
																	
																	
																	No digital/typed text, shadows, or borders.
																	
																	
																	Must be clear and not shaky or pixelated.
																	
																
																
															

															⚠️ Important Notes

															
																
																Rejection Risk: Applications with blurred photos or blurred/miniature signatures will be rejected.
																
																
																Verification: You must check the preview carefully before final submission.
																
																
																No Edits: No requests for corrections or replacements will be accepted after the final submission.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Instructions for applicants
															(For registration and submission of the online application form)

															Part A: One-Time Registration (OTR)

															
																
																Registration Link: Applicants must register at indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement to obtain a unique Registration Number.
																
																
																Prerequisites: You must have an active mobile number and email ID, both of which will be verified via OTP.
																
																
																Required Details: Keep your 10th-grade (Matriculation) board information and passing year ready.
																
																
																Mandatory Info: You will need to enter personal details (Name, DOB, Gender, Parents' names, etc.) exactly as they appear on your 10th-grade certificate.
																
																
																Credentials: After submission, a registration number and a random password will be sent to your mobile.
																
																
																Restrictions: * Mobile numbers and email IDs cannot be modified once registered.

																
																	
																	Only one registration per mobile number/email ID is allowed.
																	
																	
																	Duplicate registrations through altered details will lead to removal from the selection process.
																	
																
																
															

															 

															Part B: Filling of Online Application

															
																
																Login: Use your Registration Number and the password received via SMS.
																
																
																Application Stages:

																
																	
																	Personal Details: These are auto-populated from your OTR data; you must fill in any remaining info.
																	
																	
																	Educational Details: Select your 10th-class board, passing year, and enter your marks.
																	
																	
																	Post Preference: Select your preferred Division and post based on the local language you studied.
																	
																	
																	Uploads: You must upload a recent photo and signature according to the specific prescribed formats.
																	
																
																
																
																Final Review: You can preview and edit your application before the final submission.
																
																
																Fee Payment: If applicable, the system will prompt for payment before the final submission.
																
															

															 

															Critical Reminders

															
																
																Accuracy: Incorrect information, especially regarding your name or parents' names, may result in the cancellation of your candidature.
																
																
																Edits: Registration details can only be edited during the application submission process by clicking "Click here to update the registration data".
																
															
															
														
														
															
															India Post GDS July 2026: Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale:  BPM- Rs.12,000- 14,500 /-  ||  ABPM/ Dak Sevak-Rs.10,000- 12,000/-
																Selection Process:- Selection on the Basis of Merit List.
															
															
														
														
														
	
	📋 How to Apply India Post GDS July 2026 Online Form (Schedule-II)

	
		Visit the official GDS portal indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement.
		Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) from 31 August 2026 to 19 September 2026 (upto 5:00 PM) using mobile number and email ID.
		Log in with your Registration Number and the password received on SMS.
		Click “Apply Online” under GDS Online Engagement Schedule-II, July-2026 (Active Notification).
		Fill personal and educational details exactly as per 10th / Matriculation certificate, select one Division and post preferences (BPM / ABPM / Dak Sevak).
		Upload recent photograph and signature in the prescribed JPG/JPEG format.
		Pay the application fee of Rs. 100 online (if applicable). Fee is exempted for Female, SC/ST, PwBD and Transwomen candidates.
		Submit the form between 02 September 2026 and 21 September 2026 (upto 5:00 PM) and take a printout of the confirmation page.
	

	Note: Apply only through the official portal. No documents other than photo and signature need to be uploaded with the form. Correction window: 23–24 September 2026 (upto 5:00 PM).

															India Post GDS July 2026: Document Required to Be Uploaded

															1. Recent Photograph Requirements

															
																
																Format: JPG/JPEG only.
																
																
																File Size: Between 30 KB and 100 KB.
																
																
																Dimensions: Recommended 320 × 400 pixels (4:5 aspect ratio).
																
																
																Resolution: 72 to 150 DPI.
																
																
																Appearance: * Plain white or light-colored background.

																
																	
																	Face must occupy 70–80% of the frame.
																	
																	
																	Must be clear, well-lit, and in focus (no selfies or scanned photos).
																	
																
																
															

															2. Signature Requirements

															
																
																Format: JPG/JPEG only.
																
																
																File Size: Between 20 KB and 100 KB.
																
																
																Dimensions: Recommended 300 × 120 pixels (5:2 aspect ratio).
																
																
																Method: Scanned signature on white paper using a black or blue pen.
																
																
																Appearance:

																
																	
																	Signature must occupy 70–80% of the image area.
																	
																	
																	No digital/typed text, shadows, or borders.
																	
																	
																	Must be clear and not shaky or pixelated.
																	
																
																
															

															⚠️ Important Notes

															
																
																Rejection Risk: Applications with blurred photos or blurred/miniature signatures will be rejected.
																
																
																Verification: You must check the preview carefully before final submission.
																
																
																No Edits: No requests for corrections or replacements will be accepted after the final submission.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Instructions for applicants
															(For registration and submission of the online application form)

															Part A: One-Time Registration (OTR)

															
																
																Registration Link: Applicants must register at indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement to obtain a unique Registration Number.
																
																
																Prerequisites: You must have an active mobile number and email ID, both of which will be verified via OTP.
																
																
																Required Details: Keep your 10th-grade (Matriculation) board information and passing year ready.
																
																
																Mandatory Info: You will need to enter personal details (Name, DOB, Gender, Parents' names, etc.) exactly as they appear on your 10th-grade certificate.
																
																
																Credentials: After submission, a registration number and a random password will be sent to your mobile.
																
																
																Restrictions: * Mobile numbers and email IDs cannot be modified once registered.

																
																	
																	Only one registration per mobile number/email ID is allowed.
																	
																	
																	Duplicate registrations through altered details will lead to removal from the selection process.
																	
																
																
															

															 

															Part B: Filling of Online Application

															
																
																Login: Use your Registration Number and the password received via SMS.
																
																
																Application Stages:

																
																	
																	Personal Details: These are auto-populated from your OTR data; you must fill in any remaining info.
																	
																	
																	Educational Details: Select your 10th-class board, passing year, and enter your marks.
																	
																	
																	Post Preference: Select your preferred Division and post based on the local language you studied.
																	
																	
																	Uploads: You must upload a recent photo and signature according to the specific prescribed formats.
																	
																
																
																
																Final Review: You can preview and edit your application before the final submission.
																
																
																Fee Payment: If applicable, the system will prompt for payment before the final submission.
																
															

															 

															Critical Reminders

															
																
																Accuracy: Incorrect information, especially regarding your name or parents' names, may result in the cancellation of your candidature.
																
																
																Edits: Registration details can only be edited during the application submission process by clicking "Click here to update the registration data".
																
															
															
														
														
															
															India Post GDS July 2026: Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale:  BPM- Rs.12,000- 14,500 /-  ||  ABPM/ Dak Sevak-Rs.10,000- 12,000/-
																Selection Process:- Selection on the Basis of Merit List.

															India Post GDS July 2026: Document Required to Be Uploaded

															1. Recent Photograph Requirements

															
																
																Format: JPG/JPEG only.
																
																
																File Size: Between 30 KB and 100 KB.
																
																
																Dimensions: Recommended 320 × 400 pixels (4:5 aspect ratio).
																
																
																Resolution: 72 to 150 DPI.
																
																
																Appearance: * Plain white or light-colored background.

																
																	
																	Face must occupy 70–80% of the frame.
																	
																	
																	Must be clear, well-lit, and in focus (no selfies or scanned photos).
																	
																
																
															

															2. Signature Requirements

															
																
																Format: JPG/JPEG only.
																
																
																File Size: Between 20 KB and 100 KB.
																
																
																Dimensions: Recommended 300 × 120 pixels (5:2 aspect ratio).
																
																
																Method: Scanned signature on white paper using a black or blue pen.
																
																
																Appearance:

																
																	
																	Signature must occupy 70–80% of the image area.
																	
																	
																	No digital/typed text, shadows, or borders.
																	
																	
																	Must be clear and not shaky or pixelated.
																	
																
																
															

															⚠️ Important Notes

															
																
																Rejection Risk: Applications with blurred photos or blurred/miniature signatures will be rejected.
																
																
																Verification: You must check the preview carefully before final submission.
																
																
																No Edits: No requests for corrections or replacements will be accepted after the final submission.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Instructions for applicants
															(For registration and submission of the online application form)

															Part A: One-Time Registration (OTR)

															
																
																Registration Link: Applicants must register at indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement to obtain a unique Registration Number.
																
																
																Prerequisites: You must have an active mobile number and email ID, both of which will be verified via OTP.
																
																
																Required Details: Keep your 10th-grade (Matriculation) board information and passing year ready.
																
																
																Mandatory Info: You will need to enter personal details (Name, DOB, Gender, Parents' names, etc.) exactly as they appear on your 10th-grade certificate.
																
																
																Credentials: After submission, a registration number and a random password will be sent to your mobile.
																
																
																Restrictions: * Mobile numbers and email IDs cannot be modified once registered.

																
																	
																	Only one registration per mobile number/email ID is allowed.
																	
																	
																	Duplicate registrations through altered details will lead to removal from the selection process.
																	
																
																
															

															 

															Part B: Filling of Online Application

															
																
																Login: Use your Registration Number and the password received via SMS.
																
																
																Application Stages:

																
																	
																	Personal Details: These are auto-populated from your OTR data; you must fill in any remaining info.
																	
																	
																	Educational Details: Select your 10th-class board, passing year, and enter your marks.
																	
																	
																	Post Preference: Select your preferred Division and post based on the local language you studied.
																	
																	
																	Uploads: You must upload a recent photo and signature according to the specific prescribed formats.
																	
																
																
																
																Final Review: You can preview and edit your application before the final submission.
																
																
																Fee Payment: If applicable, the system will prompt for payment before the final submission.
																
															

															 

															Critical Reminders

															
																
																Accuracy: Incorrect information, especially regarding your name or parents' names, may result in the cancellation of your candidature.
																
																
																Edits: Registration details can only be edited during the application submission process by clicking "Click here to update the registration data".
																
															
															
														
														
															
															India Post GDS July 2026: Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale:  BPM- Rs.12,000- 14,500 /-  ||  ABPM/ Dak Sevak-Rs.10,000- 12,000/-
																Selection Process:- Selection on the Basis of Merit List.

															India Post GDS July 2026: Document Required to Be Uploaded

															1. Recent Photograph Requirements

															
																
																Format: JPG/JPEG only.
																
																
																File Size: Between 30 KB and 100 KB.
																
																
																Dimensions: Recommended 320 × 400 pixels (4:5 aspect ratio).
																
																
																Resolution: 72 to 150 DPI.
																
																
																Appearance: * Plain white or light-colored background.

																
																	
																	Face must occupy 70–80% of the frame.
																	
																	
																	Must be clear, well-lit, and in focus (no selfies or scanned photos).
																	
																
																
															

															2. Signature Requirements

															
																
																Format: JPG/JPEG only.
																
																
																File Size: Between 20 KB and 100 KB.
																
																
																Dimensions: Recommended 300 × 120 pixels (5:2 aspect ratio).
																
																
																Method: Scanned signature on white paper using a black or blue pen.
																
																
																Appearance:

																
																	
																	Signature must occupy 70–80% of the image area.
																	
																	
																	No digital/typed text, shadows, or borders.
																	
																	
																	Must be clear and not shaky or pixelated.
																	
																
																
															

															⚠️ Important Notes

															
																
																Rejection Risk: Applications with blurred photos or blurred/miniature signatures will be rejected.
																
																
																Verification: You must check the preview carefully before final submission.
																
																
																No Edits: No requests for corrections or replacements will be accepted after the final submission.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Instructions for applicants
															(For registration and submission of the online application form)

															Part A: One-Time Registration (OTR)

															
																
																Registration Link: Applicants must register at indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement to obtain a unique Registration Number.
																
																
																Prerequisites: You must have an active mobile number and email ID, both of which will be verified via OTP.
																
																
																Required Details: Keep your 10th-grade (Matriculation) board information and passing year ready.
																
																
																Mandatory Info: You will need to enter personal details (Name, DOB, Gender, Parents' names, etc.) exactly as they appear on your 10th-grade certificate.
																
																
																Credentials: After submission, a registration number and a random password will be sent to your mobile.
																
																
																Restrictions: * Mobile numbers and email IDs cannot be modified once registered.

																
																	
																	Only one registration per mobile number/email ID is allowed.
																	
																	
																	Duplicate registrations through altered details will lead to removal from the selection process.
																	
																
																
															

															 

															Part B: Filling of Online Application

															
																
																Login: Use your Registration Number and the password received via SMS.
																
																
																Application Stages:

																
																	
																	Personal Details: These are auto-populated from your OTR data; you must fill in any remaining info.
																	
																	
																	Educational Details: Select your 10th-class board, passing year, and enter your marks.
																	
																	
																	Post Preference: Select your preferred Division and post based on the local language you studied.
																	
																	
																	Uploads: You must upload a recent photo and signature according to the specific prescribed formats.
																	
																
																
																
																Final Review: You can preview and edit your application before the final submission.
																
																
																Fee Payment: If applicable, the system will prompt for payment before the final submission.
																
															

															 

															Critical Reminders

															
																
																Accuracy: Incorrect information, especially regarding your name or parents' names, may result in the cancellation of your candidature.
																
																
																Edits: Registration details can only be edited during the application submission process by clicking "Click here to update the registration data".
																
															
															
														
														
															
															India Post GDS July 2026: Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale:  BPM- Rs.12,000- 14,500 /-  ||  ABPM/ Dak Sevak-Rs.10,000- 12,000/-
																Selection Process:- Selection on the Basis of Merit List.
															
															
														
														
														
	
	📋 How to Apply India Post GDS July 2026 Online Form (Schedule-II)

	
		Visit the official GDS portal indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement.
		Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) from 31 August 2026 to 19 September 2026 (upto 5:00 PM) using mobile number and email ID.
		Log in with your Registration Number and the password received on SMS.
		Click “Apply Online” under GDS Online Engagement Schedule-II, July-2026 (Active Notification).
		Fill personal and educational details exactly as per 10th / Matriculation certificate, select one Division and post preferences (BPM / ABPM / Dak Sevak).
		Upload recent photograph and signature in the prescribed JPG/JPEG format.
		Pay the application fee of Rs. 100 online (if applicable). Fee is exempted for Female, SC/ST, PwBD and Transwomen candidates.
		Submit the form between 02 September 2026 and 21 September 2026 (upto 5:00 PM) and take a printout of the confirmation page.
	

	Note: Apply only through the official portal. No documents other than photo and signature need to be uploaded with the form. Correction window: 23–24 September 2026 (upto 5:00 PM).

																Format: JPG/JPEG only.

																	Must be clear and not shaky or pixelated.

															India Post GDS July 2026: Document Required to Be Uploaded

															1. Recent Photograph Requirements

															
																
																Format: JPG/JPEG only.
																
																
																File Size: Between 30 KB and 100 KB.
																
																
																Dimensions: Recommended 320 × 400 pixels (4:5 aspect ratio).
																
																
																Resolution: 72 to 150 DPI.
																
																
																Appearance: * Plain white or light-colored background.

																
																	
																	Face must occupy 70–80% of the frame.
																	
																	
																	Must be clear, well-lit, and in focus (no selfies or scanned photos).
																	
																
																
															

															2. Signature Requirements

															
																
																Format: JPG/JPEG only.
																
																
																File Size: Between 20 KB and 100 KB.
																
																
																Dimensions: Recommended 300 × 120 pixels (5:2 aspect ratio).
																
																
																Method: Scanned signature on white paper using a black or blue pen.
																
																
																Appearance:

																
																	
																	Signature must occupy 70–80% of the image area.
																	
																	
																	No digital/typed text, shadows, or borders.
																	
																	
																	Must be clear and not shaky or pixelated.
																	
																
																
															

															⚠️ Important Notes

															
																
																Rejection Risk: Applications with blurred photos or blurred/miniature signatures will be rejected.
																
																
																Verification: You must check the preview carefully before final submission.
																
																
																No Edits: No requests for corrections or replacements will be accepted after the final submission.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Instructions for applicants
															(For registration and submission of the online application form)

															Part A: One-Time Registration (OTR)

															
																
																Registration Link: Applicants must register at indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement to obtain a unique Registration Number.
																
																
																Prerequisites: You must have an active mobile number and email ID, both of which will be verified via OTP.
																
																
																Required Details: Keep your 10th-grade (Matriculation) board information and passing year ready.
																
																
																Mandatory Info: You will need to enter personal details (Name, DOB, Gender, Parents' names, etc.) exactly as they appear on your 10th-grade certificate.
																
																
																Credentials: After submission, a registration number and a random password will be sent to your mobile.
																
																
																Restrictions: * Mobile numbers and email IDs cannot be modified once registered.

																
																	
																	Only one registration per mobile number/email ID is allowed.
																	
																	
																	Duplicate registrations through altered details will lead to removal from the selection process.
																	
																
																
															

															 

															Part B: Filling of Online Application

															
																
																Login: Use your Registration Number and the password received via SMS.
																
																
																Application Stages:

																
																	
																	Personal Details: These are auto-populated from your OTR data; you must fill in any remaining info.
																	
																	
																	Educational Details: Select your 10th-class board, passing year, and enter your marks.
																	
																	
																	Post Preference: Select your preferred Division and post based on the local language you studied.
																	
																	
																	Uploads: You must upload a recent photo and signature according to the specific prescribed formats.
																	
																
																
																
																Final Review: You can preview and edit your application before the final submission.
																
																
																Fee Payment: If applicable, the system will prompt for payment before the final submission.
																
															

															 

															Critical Reminders

															
																
																Accuracy: Incorrect information, especially regarding your name or parents' names, may result in the cancellation of your candidature.
																
																
																Edits: Registration details can only be edited during the application submission process by clicking "Click here to update the registration data".
																
															
															
														
														
															
															India Post GDS July 2026: Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale:  BPM- Rs.12,000- 14,500 /-  ||  ABPM/ Dak Sevak-Rs.10,000- 12,000/-
																Selection Process:- Selection on the Basis of Merit List.

															India Post GDS July 2026: Document Required to Be Uploaded

															1. Recent Photograph Requirements

															
																
																Format: JPG/JPEG only.
																
																
																File Size: Between 30 KB and 100 KB.
																
																
																Dimensions: Recommended 320 × 400 pixels (4:5 aspect ratio).
																
																
																Resolution: 72 to 150 DPI.
																
																
																Appearance: * Plain white or light-colored background.

																
																	
																	Face must occupy 70–80% of the frame.
																	
																	
																	Must be clear, well-lit, and in focus (no selfies or scanned photos).
																	
																
																
															

															2. Signature Requirements

															
																
																Format: JPG/JPEG only.
																
																
																File Size: Between 20 KB and 100 KB.
																
																
																Dimensions: Recommended 300 × 120 pixels (5:2 aspect ratio).
																
																
																Method: Scanned signature on white paper using a black or blue pen.
																
																
																Appearance:

																
																	
																	Signature must occupy 70–80% of the image area.
																	
																	
																	No digital/typed text, shadows, or borders.
																	
																	
																	Must be clear and not shaky or pixelated.
																	
																
																
															

															⚠️ Important Notes

															
																
																Rejection Risk: Applications with blurred photos or blurred/miniature signatures will be rejected.
																
																
																Verification: You must check the preview carefully before final submission.
																
																
																No Edits: No requests for corrections or replacements will be accepted after the final submission.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Instructions for applicants
															(For registration and submission of the online application form)

															Part A: One-Time Registration (OTR)

															
																
																Registration Link: Applicants must register at indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement to obtain a unique Registration Number.
																
																
																Prerequisites: You must have an active mobile number and email ID, both of which will be verified via OTP.
																
																
																Required Details: Keep your 10th-grade (Matriculation) board information and passing year ready.
																
																
																Mandatory Info: You will need to enter personal details (Name, DOB, Gender, Parents' names, etc.) exactly as they appear on your 10th-grade certificate.
																
																
																Credentials: After submission, a registration number and a random password will be sent to your mobile.
																
																
																Restrictions: * Mobile numbers and email IDs cannot be modified once registered.

																
																	
																	Only one registration per mobile number/email ID is allowed.
																	
																	
																	Duplicate registrations through altered details will lead to removal from the selection process.
																	
																
																
															

															 

															Part B: Filling of Online Application

															
																
																Login: Use your Registration Number and the password received via SMS.
																
																
																Application Stages:

																
																	
																	Personal Details: These are auto-populated from your OTR data; you must fill in any remaining info.
																	
																	
																	Educational Details: Select your 10th-class board, passing year, and enter your marks.
																	
																	
																	Post Preference: Select your preferred Division and post based on the local language you studied.
																	
																	
																	Uploads: You must upload a recent photo and signature according to the specific prescribed formats.
																	
																
																
																
																Final Review: You can preview and edit your application before the final submission.
																
																
																Fee Payment: If applicable, the system will prompt for payment before the final submission.
																
															

															 

															Critical Reminders

															
																
																Accuracy: Incorrect information, especially regarding your name or parents' names, may result in the cancellation of your candidature.
																
																
																Edits: Registration details can only be edited during the application submission process by clicking "Click here to update the registration data".
																
															
															
														
														
															
															India Post GDS July 2026: Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale:  BPM- Rs.12,000- 14,500 /-  ||  ABPM/ Dak Sevak-Rs.10,000- 12,000/-
																Selection Process:- Selection on the Basis of Merit List.

		Visit the official GDS portal indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement.
		Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) from 31 August 2026 to 19 September 2026 (upto 5:00 PM) using mobile number and email ID.
		Log in with your Registration Number and the password received on SMS.
		Click “Apply Online” under GDS Online Engagement Schedule-II, July-2026 (Active Notification).
		Fill personal and educational details exactly as per 10th / Matriculation certificate, select one Division and post preferences (BPM / ABPM / Dak Sevak).
		Upload recent photograph and signature in the prescribed JPG/JPEG format.

		Submit the form between 02 September 2026 and 21 September 2026 (upto 5:00 PM) and take a printout of the confirmation page.
	

	Note: Apply only through the official portal. No documents other than photo and signature need to be uploaded with the form. Correction window: 23–24 September 2026 (upto 5:00 PM).

															India Post GDS July 2026: Document Required to Be Uploaded

															1. Recent Photograph Requirements

															
																
																Format: JPG/JPEG only.
																
																
																File Size: Between 30 KB and 100 KB.
																
																
																Dimensions: Recommended 320 × 400 pixels (4:5 aspect ratio).
																
																
																Resolution: 72 to 150 DPI.
																
																
																Appearance: * Plain white or light-colored background.

																
																	
																	Face must occupy 70–80% of the frame.
																	
																	
																	Must be clear, well-lit, and in focus (no selfies or scanned photos).
																	
																
																
															

															2. Signature Requirements

															
																
																Format: JPG/JPEG only.
																
																
																File Size: Between 20 KB and 100 KB.
																
																
																Dimensions: Recommended 300 × 120 pixels (5:2 aspect ratio).
																
																
																Method: Scanned signature on white paper using a black or blue pen.
																
																
																Appearance:

																
																	
																	Signature must occupy 70–80% of the image area.
																	
																	
																	No digital/typed text, shadows, or borders.
																	
																	
																	Must be clear and not shaky or pixelated.
																	
																
																
															

															⚠️ Important Notes

															
																
																Rejection Risk: Applications with blurred photos or blurred/miniature signatures will be rejected.
																
																
																Verification: You must check the preview carefully before final submission.
																
																
																No Edits: No requests for corrections or replacements will be accepted after the final submission.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Instructions for applicants
															(For registration and submission of the online application form)

															Part A: One-Time Registration (OTR)

															
																
																Registration Link: Applicants must register at indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement to obtain a unique Registration Number.
																
																
																Prerequisites: You must have an active mobile number and email ID, both of which will be verified via OTP.
																
																
																Required Details: Keep your 10th-grade (Matriculation) board information and passing year ready.
																
																
																Mandatory Info: You will need to enter personal details (Name, DOB, Gender, Parents' names, etc.) exactly as they appear on your 10th-grade certificate.
																
																
																Credentials: After submission, a registration number and a random password will be sent to your mobile.
																
																
																Restrictions: * Mobile numbers and email IDs cannot be modified once registered.

																
																	
																	Only one registration per mobile number/email ID is allowed.
																	
																	
																	Duplicate registrations through altered details will lead to removal from the selection process.
																	
																
																
															

															 

															Part B: Filling of Online Application

															
																
																Login: Use your Registration Number and the password received via SMS.
																
																
																Application Stages:

																
																	
																	Personal Details: These are auto-populated from your OTR data; you must fill in any remaining info.
																	
																	
																	Educational Details: Select your 10th-class board, passing year, and enter your marks.
																	
																	
																	Post Preference: Select your preferred Division and post based on the local language you studied.
																	
																	
																	Uploads: You must upload a recent photo and signature according to the specific prescribed formats.
																	
																
																
																
																Final Review: You can preview and edit your application before the final submission.
																
																
																Fee Payment: If applicable, the system will prompt for payment before the final submission.
																
															

															 

															Critical Reminders

															
																
																Accuracy: Incorrect information, especially regarding your name or parents' names, may result in the cancellation of your candidature.
																
																
																Edits: Registration details can only be edited during the application submission process by clicking "Click here to update the registration data".
																
															
															
														
														
															
															India Post GDS July 2026: Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale:  BPM- Rs.12,000- 14,500 /-  ||  ABPM/ Dak Sevak-Rs.10,000- 12,000/-
																Selection Process:- Selection on the Basis of Merit List.

		Visit the official GDS portal indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement.
		Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) from 31 August 2026 to 19 September 2026 (upto 5:00 PM) using mobile number and email ID.
		Log in with your Registration Number and the password received on SMS.
		Click “Apply Online” under GDS Online Engagement Schedule-II, July-2026 (Active Notification).
		Fill personal and educational details exactly as per 10th / Matriculation certificate, select one Division and post preferences (BPM / ABPM / Dak Sevak).

	Note: Apply only through the official portal. No documents other than photo and signature need to be uploaded with the form. Correction window: 23–24 September 2026 (upto 5:00 PM).

															India Post GDS July 2026: Document Required to Be Uploaded

															1. Recent Photograph Requirements

															
																
																Format: JPG/JPEG only.
																
																
																File Size: Between 30 KB and 100 KB.
																
																
																Dimensions: Recommended 320 × 400 pixels (4:5 aspect ratio).
																
																
																Resolution: 72 to 150 DPI.
																
																
																Appearance: * Plain white or light-colored background.

																
																	
																	Face must occupy 70–80% of the frame.
																	
																	
																	Must be clear, well-lit, and in focus (no selfies or scanned photos).
																	
																
																
															

															2. Signature Requirements

															
																
																Format: JPG/JPEG only.
																
																
																File Size: Between 20 KB and 100 KB.
																
																
																Dimensions: Recommended 300 × 120 pixels (5:2 aspect ratio).
																
																
																Method: Scanned signature on white paper using a black or blue pen.
																
																
																Appearance:

																
																	
																	Signature must occupy 70–80% of the image area.
																	
																	
																	No digital/typed text, shadows, or borders.
																	
																	
																	Must be clear and not shaky or pixelated.
																	
																
																
															

															⚠️ Important Notes

															
																
																Rejection Risk: Applications with blurred photos or blurred/miniature signatures will be rejected.
																
																
																Verification: You must check the preview carefully before final submission.
																
																
																No Edits: No requests for corrections or replacements will be accepted after the final submission.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Instructions for applicants
															(For registration and submission of the online application form)

															Part A: One-Time Registration (OTR)

															
																
																Registration Link: Applicants must register at indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement to obtain a unique Registration Number.
																
																
																Prerequisites: You must have an active mobile number and email ID, both of which will be verified via OTP.
																
																
																Required Details: Keep your 10th-grade (Matriculation) board information and passing year ready.
																
																
																Mandatory Info: You will need to enter personal details (Name, DOB, Gender, Parents' names, etc.) exactly as they appear on your 10th-grade certificate.
																
																
																Credentials: After submission, a registration number and a random password will be sent to your mobile.
																
																
																Restrictions: * Mobile numbers and email IDs cannot be modified once registered.

																
																	
																	Only one registration per mobile number/email ID is allowed.
																	
																	
																	Duplicate registrations through altered details will lead to removal from the selection process.
																	
																
																
															

															 

															Part B: Filling of Online Application

															
																
																Login: Use your Registration Number and the password received via SMS.
																
																
																Application Stages:

																
																	
																	Personal Details: These are auto-populated from your OTR data; you must fill in any remaining info.
																	
																	
																	Educational Details: Select your 10th-class board, passing year, and enter your marks.
																	
																	
																	Post Preference: Select your preferred Division and post based on the local language you studied.
																	
																	
																	Uploads: You must upload a recent photo and signature according to the specific prescribed formats.
																	
																
																
																
																Final Review: You can preview and edit your application before the final submission.
																
																
																Fee Payment: If applicable, the system will prompt for payment before the final submission.
																
															

															 

															Critical Reminders

															
																
																Accuracy: Incorrect information, especially regarding your name or parents' names, may result in the cancellation of your candidature.
																
																
																Edits: Registration details can only be edited during the application submission process by clicking "Click here to update the registration data".
																
															
															
														
														
															
															India Post GDS July 2026: Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																Pay Scale:  BPM- Rs.12,000- 14,500 /-  ||  ABPM/ Dak Sevak-Rs.10,000- 12,000/-
																Selection Process:- Selection on the Basis of Merit List.
															
															
														
														
														
	
	📋 How to Apply India Post GDS July 2026 Online Form (Schedule-II)

	
		Visit the official GDS portal indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement.
		Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) from 31 August 2026 to 19 September 2026 (upto 5:00 PM) using mobile number and email ID.
		Log in with your Registration Number and the password received on SMS.
		Click “Apply Online” under GDS Online Engagement Schedule-II, July-2026 (Active Notification).
		Fill personal and educational details exactly as per 10th / Matriculation certificate, select one Division and post preferences (BPM / ABPM / Dak Sevak).
		Upload recent photograph and signature in the prescribed JPG/JPEG format.
		Pay the application fee of Rs. 100 online (if applicable). Fee is exempted for Female, SC/ST, PwBD and Transwomen candidates.
		Submit the form between 02 September 2026 and 21 September 2026 (upto 5:00 PM) and take a printout of the confirmation page.
	

	Note: Apply only through the official portal. No documents other than photo and signature need to be uploaded with the form. Correction window: 23–24 September 2026 (upto 5:00 PM).

															India Post GDS July 2026: Document Required to Be Uploaded

															1. Recent Photograph Requirements

															
																
																Format: JPG/JPEG only.
																
																
																File Size: Between 30 KB and 100 KB.
																
																
																Dimensions: Recommended 320 × 400 pixels (4:5 aspect ratio).
																
																
																Resolution: 72 to 150 DPI.
																
																
																Appearance: * Plain white or light-colored background.

																
																	
																	Face must occupy 70–80% of the frame.
																	
																	
																	Must be clear, well-lit, and in focus (no selfies or scanned photos).
																	
																
																
															

															2. Signature Requirements

															
																
																Format: JPG/JPEG only.
																
																
																File Size: Between 20 KB and 100 KB.
																
																
																Dimensions: Recommended 300 × 120 pixels (5:2 aspect ratio).
																
																
																Method: Scanned signature on white paper using a black or blue pen.
																
																
																Appearance:

																
																	
																	Signature must occupy 70–80% of the image area.
																	
																	
																	No digital/typed text, shadows, or borders.
																	
																	
																	Must be clear and not shaky or pixelated.
																	
																
																
															

															⚠️ Important Notes

															
																
																Rejection Risk: Applications with blurred photos or blurred/miniature signatures will be rejected.
																
																
																Verification: You must check the preview carefully before final submission.
																
																
																No Edits: No requests for corrections or replacements will be accepted after the final submission.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Instructions for applicants
															(For registration and submission of the online application form)

															Part A: One-Time Registration (OTR)

															
																
																Registration Link: Applicants must register at indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement to obtain a unique Registration Number.
																
																
																Prerequisites: You must have an active mobile number and email ID, both of which will be verified via OTP.
																
																
																Required Details: Keep your 10th-grade (Matriculation) board information and passing year ready.
																
																
																Mandatory Info: You will need to enter personal details (Name, DOB, Gender, Parents' names, etc.) exactly as they appear on your 10th-grade certificate.
																
																
																Credentials: After submission, a registration number and a random password will be sent to your mobile.
																
																
																Restrictions: * Mobile numbers and email IDs cannot be modified once registered.

																
																	
																	Only one registration per mobile number/email ID is allowed.
																	
																	
																	Duplicate registrations through altered details will lead to removal from the selection process.
																	
																
																
															

															 

															Part B: Filling of Online Application

															
																
																Login: Use your Registration Number and the password received via SMS.
																
																
																Application Stages:

																
																	
																	Personal Details: These are auto-populated from your OTR data; you must fill in any remaining info.
																	
																	
																	Educational Details: Select your 10th-class board, passing year, and enter your marks.
																	
																	
																	Post Preference: Select your preferred Division and post based on the local language you studied.
																	
																	
																	Uploads: You must upload a recent photo and signature according to the specific prescribed formats.
																	
																
																
																
																Final Review: You can preview and edit your application before the final submission.
																
																
																Fee Payment: If applicable, the system will prompt for payment before the final submission.
																
															

															 

															Critical Reminders

															
																
																Accuracy: Incorrect information, especially regarding your name or parents' names, may result in the cancellation of your candidature.
																
																
																Edits: Registration details can only be edited during the application submission process by clicking "Click here to update the registration data".
